description: This file defines utility functions and classes related to the registration and handling of ufunc kernels, types, and arguments within the PyTorch code generation framework. It includes functions to generate kernel names, determine dispatch types, and manage argument bindings for CUDA and CPU implementations, specifically targeting ufunc-related functionality.

classes.name: UfunctorBindings
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the constructor and apply bindings for ufunctors.

methods.name: str schema_kernel_name(func: FunctionSchema, dispatch_key: DispatchKey)
methods.description: Generates the kernel name for a given function schema and dispatch key.

methods.name: str kernel_name(g: NativeFunctionsGroup, dispatch_key: DispatchKey)
methods.description: Generates the kernel name for a NativeFunctionsGroup and dispatch key.

methods.name: NamedCType|None dispatchstub_type(t: Type, *, binds: ArgName)
methods.description: Determines the dispatch stub type based on the provided argument type, returning a NamedCType or None.

methods.name: BaseCppType opmath_type(scalar_t: BaseCppType)
methods.description: Converts a scalar type to its operation math type, or raises NotImplementedError if unsupported.

methods.name: NamedCType ufunctor_ctor_type(t: Type, *, binds: ArgName, scalar_t: BaseCppType)
methods.description: Determines the constructor type for ufunctors based on the argument type.

methods.name: NamedCType ufunctor_apply_type( t: Type, *, binds: ArgName, scalar_t: BaseCppType )
methods.description: Determines the apply type for ufunctors based on the argument type.

methods.name: NamedCType ufunc_type(t: Type, *, binds: ArgName, compute_t: CType)
methods.description: Generates the computation type for a ufunc based on the argument type and compute type.

methods.name: Binding ufunctor_ctor_argument(a: Argument, scalar_t: BaseCppType)
methods.description: Creates a Binding object for a constructor argument.

methods.name: Binding ufunctor_apply_argument(a: Argument, scalar_t: BaseCppType)
methods.description: Creates a Binding object for an apply argument.

methods.name: Binding ufunc_argument(a: Argument, compute_t: CType)
methods.description: Creates a Binding object for a ufunc argument.

methods.name: UfunctorBindings ufunctor_arguments( g: NativeFunctionsGroup, *, scalar_tensor_idx: int | None, scalar_t: BaseCppType )
methods.description: Generates constructor and apply bindings for a ufunctor, considering tensor indices.

methods.name: list[Binding] ufunc_arguments(g: NativeFunctionsGroup, *, compute_t: CType)
methods.description: Generates a list of argument bindings for a ufunc based on the compute type.

methods.name: list[Binding] stub_arguments(g: NativeFunctionsGroup)
methods.description: Generates the arguments for dispatch stubs, excluding tensor arguments.

ctags.name: dispatchstub_type
ctags.pattern: /^def dispatchstub_type(t: Type, *, binds: ArgName) -> NamedCType | None:$/

ctags.name: ufunc_type
ctags.pattern: /^def ufunc_type(t: Type, *, binds: ArgName, compute_t: CType) -> NamedCType:$/

ctags.name: ufunctor_apply_type
ctags.signature: ( t: Type, *, binds: ArgName, scalar_t: BaseCppType )

ctags.name: ufunctor_arguments
ctags.signature: ( g: NativeFunctionsGroup, *, scalar_tensor_idx: int | None, scalar_t: BaseCppType )

ctags.name: ufunctor_ctor_type
ctags.pattern: /^def ufunctor_ctor_type(t: Type, *, binds: ArgName, scalar_t: BaseCppType) -> NamedCType:$/
